title: Microstructure and Compressive Properties of NbTiVTaAlx High Entropy Alloys
process_description: prepared by arc melting the mixtures of high-purity metals (purity >99 wt%) under a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere on a water-cooled Cu hearth. The alloys were remelted several times and flipped each time to improve homogeneity.
